source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Applying mainly to injuries that happen to occur within a hospital setting, rather than to injuries more broadly","B":"Carrying fairly little established relationship to a client's expected outcomes or how their care is actually planned","C":"Guide clinical management decisions and provide a general framework for prognosis, though individual outcomes can vary considerably","D":"Taking the place of the ongoing clinical assessment the nurse would otherwise still need to perform regularly"}}
source_row.rationale: TBI severity classification (commonly mild, moderate, or severe, based on factors including GCS score and duration of loss of consciousness) helps guide clinical management decisions and provides a general framework for prognosis, though the nurse should recognize that individual outcomes can vary considerably even within the same classification category.
